input: Please calculate 26 one-way trips per month using the actual current single fare from Stratford to Bank.

assumptions: Each stated monthly journey counts as one single; no extra return trips or office days are inferred.
The declared monthly trip count is used directly; no weekly-to-monthly conversion is applied.
The observed single fare applies to every counted journey; discounts, caps and future fare changes are excluded.
This estimate is not verified travel cost for a particular available flat and does not establish its combined-budget eligibility.

display: Estimated monthly commuting: 26 single journeys/month × £3.10 = £80.60/month. The declared monthly trip count is used directly; no extra return trips or office days are inferred and no weekly conversion is applied. The observed fare is assumed for every trip; discounts, fare caps and future changes are excluded.
